name: CL-CRI-1131
akas: Unit 42 cluster designation; cross-referenced by CloudSEK as "Operation Escaneo"
brief: Multi-stage network intrusion and data-exfiltration campaign against Mexican transport-ministry and Ecuadorian water-utility targets. Unit 42 found a self-hosted NextChat web UI exposed on attacker infrastructure (TCP port 3000) being used to query Claude and GPT-4.1 for "troubleshooting issues faced by the attackers across their campaigns" — evidenced by iteratively-versioned Go-based SOCKS5 proxy tooling ("SockTz" v1–v9). Infrastructure overlap (SOCKS5 relays) links this cluster to CL-CRI-1163. Other TTPs: living-off-the-land techniques, VSS manipulation, batch-script exfiltration, resume/job-themed phishing lures, custom RATs, dynamic-DNS C2, multi-SAN certificates. Unit 42
ttpMd:
